مُعْقَبٌ [appears, from what here follows, to be used for مُعْقَبٌ حَالُهُ i. e. One whose state is changed]. IAar cites as an ex. of this word, “كُلُّ حَىٍّ مُعْقَبٌ عُقَبَا
” meaning [Every living being] comes to a state different from that in which he was [by turns, or time after time]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
